title: US County Economics
description: County-level GDP, personal income, AGI/wages, population, migration, industry sector shares, and household-normalized metrics for all ~3,200 US counties. Pre-computed boolean flags encode answers to thousands of common economic questions.

sources.name: BEA CAGDP2 — GDP by County and Industry
BEA CAINC1 — Personal Income, Population, Per-Capita Income
IRS Statistics of Income — County AGI and Wages
Census PEP — County Population Estimates and Migration

derived_tables.description: Cross-source numeric metrics per county-year. Primary join surface.
Household-normalized income and productivity metrics. Uses IRS filing units as household proxy.
Core boolean flags: size, income, structure, growth, composite situations.
Master view: all flags + metrics from all sources in one 96-column row per county-year. Best starting point for LLM queries.

llm_prompt_hint: Use semantic.county_all_flags for most county questions. Join key is fips (5-digit string) and year. All boolean flags are NULL (not false) when data is unavailable — use IS TRUE not = TRUE. Best year for cross-source analysis is 2022. See docs/SCHEMA_REFERENCE.md for full column descriptions and docs/GEO_CATALOG.md for FIPS lookup patterns.
